title: This Is Media Malpractice
description:
The internet is flooded with viral clips and outrage bait, and a disturbing number of them are flat-out false.

We walk through multiple viral examples, show what was left out, what was exaggerated, and what never happened at all.

This is how misinformation turns into real-world chaos.
